Title: Elysium λ Development & Research
Subtitle: Digital Infrastructure for SMEs: IT Consulting and Services for SMEs

Description:
Digital Infrastructure for SMEs. IT Consulting and Services

Elysium λ Development & Research provides enterprise-grade digital
infrastructure for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in Europe and
Latin America. Based in Bragança, Portugal, European Union. Founded January 2026.

Contact: info@elysiumdr.eu
Phone/WhatsApp: +351 934086075
Social: @elysiumdr (X/Twitter) | @elysium.dr (Instagram)

--- SERVICES PAGE ---
URL: https://elysiumdr.eu/services.html

Title: Services — Elysium λ Development & Research
Description: Zero Development Costs: High-performance digital infrastructure included in your monthly subscription.

ENTERPRISE-GRADE DIGITAL INFRASTRUCTURE

Zero Development Cost Model:
High-performance digital infrastructure included in monthly subscription.
You don't pay for website construction — each monthly fee is an investment in
an ecosystem that evolves with your business, guaranteeing peak performance,
operational security, and high lead retention.

SUBSCRIPTION TIERS:

1. Hosting Maintenance — €99/year (The Operational Core)
   - Domain management and brand digital identity.
   - Web hosting on high-availability servers (always online).
   - Base infrastructure maintenance and updates.

2. Basic Maintenance — €70/month (Level 1 Ecosystem)
   - Includes Hosting Maintenance.
   - Complete development of your corporate website.
   - Fluid design flawlessly adapted for mobile devices.
   - Ultra-fast loading times to prevent customer drop-off.
   - Inclusive and accessible structure for all types of users.
   - Contact forms shielded against spam and malicious attacks.
   - Advanced security protocols to protect your brand's reputation.
   - Full compliance with global data privacy regulations (GDPR).

3. Preferential Maintenance — €99/month (Level 2 Ecosystem)
   - Includes all Basic features.
   - Architecture prepared for future commerce and sales integrations.
   - Global expansion: Perfectly structured multi-language website.
   - Smart visual design (automatic adaptation to light/dark modes).
   - Real-time currency conversion engine for international clients.

4. Advanced Maintenance — €120/month (Level 3 Ecosystem)
   - Includes all Preferential features.
   - Private platform to manage your clients and operations (CRM).
   - User system with restricted permissions and access levels.
   - Custom-built software that scales alongside your business growth.
   - Cloud databases protected by the highest industry standards.

5. Custom Core CRM — €50/month (Independent add-on module)
   - Intuitive, elegant, and exceptionally easy-to-use control panel.
   - 100% confidential workspace entirely separated from your public site.
   - Direct and centralised access from your secure Elysium client portal.

TRANSPARENCY & LICENSING:
- Zero Development Cost: Elysium assumes 100% of initial engineering.
- Code Ownership (IP): Source code remains intellectual property of Elysium λ.
  Clients acquire a full-use licence tied to their active subscription.
- Lifecycle & Continuity: If subscription is interrupted, system and support
  will be suspended.
- Valuation & Buyout: If your business model requires total code ownership,
  we offer an auditing and valuation process for project buyout.

Title: Research — Elysium λ Development & Research

Elysium λ conducts applied research in intelligent systems, ontological

- Ontological engineering for intelligent systems
- Data-driven SME intelligence
- Applied AI for human development and sustainability

--- ABOUT PAGE ---
URL: https://elysiumdr.eu/about.html

Title: Our Ethos — Elysium λ Development & Research
Description: Mission, vision and story of Elysium λ Development and Research
— a European SME web and research company based in Portugal.

FOUNDING PHILOSOPHY:
"Our work is guided by the conviction that digital infrastructure should be
accessible, transparent, and focused on human development."

MISSION:
Investigating and developing digital systems focused on human development and
boosting SMEs through research and technological innovation.

Elysium λ Development & Research explores how intelligent systems can strengthen
the digital capabilities of small and medium-sized enterprises, enabling them
to participate in a constantly evolving interconnected world.

VISION:
Evolving into the λ Elysium Institute of Development & Research — an institute
dedicated to the study, development, and application of intelligent systems,
as well as the training of new generations of scientists and developers.

To actively contribute to the construction of a digital Europe, where artificial
intelligence, data science, and intelligent systems drive the development of
organisations and communities, always staying aligned with the highest standards
of education, the ethical development of technology, and the fundamental values
of the European Union.

--- PÁGINA DE SERVICIOS ---
URL: https://elysiumdr.eu/es/services.html

Título: Servicios — Elysium λ Development & Research
Descripción: Desarrollo web profesional, diseño, mantenimiento y soporte para
PYMEs — precios flexibles y transparentes. Portugal, Unión Europea.

INFRAESTRUCTURA DIGITAL DE NIVEL EMPRESARIAL

Modelo de Coste Cero de Desarrollo:
Infraestructura digital de alto rendimiento incluida en la suscripción mensual.
No pagas el desarrollo del sitio web — cada cuota mensual es una inversión en
un ecosistema que evoluciona con tu negocio, garantizando máximo rendimiento,
seguridad operativa y alta retención de clientes.

PLANES DE SUSCRIPCIÓN:

1. Mantenimiento de Hosting — €99/año (El Núcleo Operativo)
   - Gestión del dominio e identidad digital de marca.
   - Alojamiento web en servidores de alta disponibilidad (siempre en línea).
   - Mantenimiento y actualizaciones de infraestructura base.

2. Mantenimiento Básico — €70/mes (Ecosistema Nivel 1)
   - Incluye Mantenimiento de Hosting.
   - Desarrollo completo de tu sitio web corporativo.
   - Diseño fluido perfectamente adaptado para dispositivos móviles.
   - Tiempos de carga ultrarrápidos para evitar la pérdida de clientes.
   - Estructura inclusiva y accesible para todo tipo de usuarios.
   - Formularios de contacto protegidos contra spam y ataques maliciosos.
   - Protocolos de seguridad avanzados para proteger la reputación de tu marca.
   - Cumplimiento total con las regulaciones globales de privacidad (RGPD).

3. Mantenimiento Preferencial — €99/mes (Ecosistema Nivel 2)
   - Incluye todas las funcionalidades Básicas.
   - Arquitectura preparada para futuras integraciones de comercio y ventas.
   - Expansión global: sitio web multilingüe perfectamente estructurado.
   - Diseño visual inteligente (adaptación automática a modos claro/oscuro).
   - Motor de conversión de divisas en tiempo real para clientes internacionales.

4. Mantenimiento Avanzado — €120/mes (Ecosistema Nivel 3)
   - Incluye todas las funcionalidades Preferenciales.
   - Plataforma privada para gestionar clientes y operaciones (CRM).
   - Sistema de usuarios con permisos restringidos y niveles de acceso.
   - Software a medida que escala junto con el crecimiento de tu negocio.
   - Bases de datos en la nube protegidas por los más altos estándares.

5. CRM Core Personalizado — €50/mes (módulo complementario independiente)
   - Panel de control intuitivo, elegante y excepcionalmente fácil de usar.
   - Espacio de trabajo 100% confidencial, separado de tu sitio público.
   - Acceso directo y centralizado desde tu portal seguro de cliente Elysium.

--- SOBRE NOSOTROS ---
URL: https://elysiumdr.eu/es/about.html

Misión:
Investigar y desarrollar sistemas digitales centrados en el desarrollo humano
y el impulso de las PYMEs a través de la investigación y la innovación tecnológica.

Elysium λ explora cómo los sistemas inteligentes pueden fortalecer las capacidades
digitales de las pequeñas y medianas empresas, permitiéndoles participar en un
mundo interconectado en constante evolución.

Visión:
Evolucionar hacia el λ Elysium Institute of Development & Research — un instituto
dedicado al estudio, desarrollo y aplicación de sistemas inteligentes, así como
a la formación de nuevas generaciones de científicos y desarrolladores.

Contribuir activamente a la construcción de una Europa digital, donde la
inteligencia artificial, la ciencia de datos y los sistemas inteligentes impulsen
el desarrollo de organizaciones y comunidades, siempre alineados con los más
altos estándares de educación, el desarrollo ético de la tecnología y los valores
fundamentales de la Unión Europea.

--- SOBRE NÓS ---
URL: https://elysiumdr.eu/pt/about.html

Missão:
Investigar e desenvolver sistemas digitais centrados no desenvolvimento humano
e no impulso das PMEs através da investigação e da inovação tecnológica.

Elysium λ explora como os sistemas inteligentes podem fortalecer as capacidades
digitais das pequenas e médias empresas, permitindo-lhes participar num mundo
interligado em constante evolução.

Visão:
Evoluir para o λ Elysium Institute of Development & Research — um instituto
dedicado ao estudo, desenvolvimento e aplicação de sistemas inteligentes, bem
como à formação de novas gerações de cientistas e programadores.

Contribuir activamente para a construção de uma Europa digital, onde a inteligência
artificial, a ciência de dados e os sistemas inteligentes impulsionem o
desenvolvimento de organizações e comunidades, sempre alinhados com os mais
elevados padrões de educação, o desenvolvimento ético da tecnologia e os valores
fundamentais da União Europeia.
